why: read on 2026-11-02, the three records in scope keep qualifies-with-caveat under 4.2, so no verdict was changed; of the compute and ci-cd-runners records with needs_card=1, 15 hold fails-identity, 69 + 2 qualifies-with-caveat and 22 qualifies, so one rule needs an operator ruling and then a verify pass on every card-gated record it moves
